title: Vorthos Award Results and Keyword Flavor

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon planeswalker whose claw is shown closing in on a reunited Alara in the art of the card Conflux.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The plane of the five shards, reunited in the story of Conflux.

entities.name: Progenitus
entities.description: A hydra avatar with protection from everything and a notable backstory, winner of a Vorthos Award category.

entities.name: Asha
entities.description: An archangel whose absence is marked by a lonely, floating throne, as seen on Sigil of the Empty Throne.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The Japanese-inspired setting to which the bushido keyword is closely tied.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: A plane of artifacts with five colored suns whose ascension drives the story of Fifth Dawn.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: The Ravnica guild whose feel suits the convoke keyword.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A powerful time-mage, whose presence helps redeem the flavor of flash.

events.summary: The art of the card Conflux shows Nicol Bolas's claw closing in on the reunited Alara.
events.quote: The card's art shows Nicol Bolas's claw closing in on the five-color power of a reunited Alara

events.summary: A lonely floating throne marks the absence of the archangel Asha, as shown by Sigil of the Empty Throne.
events.quote: the story of Asha and the lonely, floating throne that marks the archangel's absence

events.summary: On Mirrodin, the five colored suns ascend, causing the dramatic changes of the Fifth Dawn story.
events.quote: Mirrodin has five colored suns, and the whole backstory of the Fifth Dawn set was related to the dramatic changes resulting from the impact of their ascension and power

relations.note: His claw is shown closing in on the reunited plane in the art of Conflux.
relations.quote: The card's art shows Nicol Bolas's claw closing in on the five-color power of a reunited Alara
